title: Charge and Quantum Electrical Standards
question: How do fixed h and e support exact quantum electrical relationships and their practical realizations?
summary: Trace fixed elementary charge and Planck's constant through exact ideal conductance, resistance, Josephson, and magnetic-flux relationships while keeping practical device realization, corrections, and uncertainty separate from pre-2019 conventional values. Vacuum permeability and permittivity are not independently fixed exact standards in the present SI.

caveats: Exact ideal relationships do not make practical realizations uncertainty-free.
